sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Applies Miasma for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 60% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Decay (Continuous debuff that renews the effect "Reduces all stats by 20% for 60 seconds" every 10 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Dawn for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Only [Debris] Herne can be used as Unlocking Potential material
